title: Quaintly Crispy Dutch Rhubarb Tagine
description: A comforting Dutch dish featuring forced-rhubarb, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, cooked in a tagine with a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a chilly evening, and friendly to dairy-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the rhubarb pieces with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the rhubarb mixture in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until tender and lightly caramelized.
In a large tagine or Dutch oven, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the tagine and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the tagine and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, and cinnamon and cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the roasted rhubarb, almond milk, and browned onion mixture to the tagine, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the rhubarb is very tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
